description.value: Puccini's Deli is a family-owned Italian specialty food shop on Lonsdale Avenue in North Vancouver, founded by the Pucci family and serving the North Shore since 2009. The store stocks over 150 specialty cheeses, aged in-house salami, premium cured meats, antipasti, and artisan oils sourced from Italy, Spain, and Greece, alongside made-to-order panini sandwiches on ciabatta or focaccia. A touring cyclist passing through North Vancouver will find it a reliable stop for a substantial sandwich and quality Italian provisions.
